reconciliation_evidence: The cited project announcement establishes facility identity and location but asserts no electrical capacity or load.
The record represents coal production; an electrical MW value is not applicable.
EIA plant 4158 has four operating units totaling 816.7 MW nameplate; alternate totals are 745 MW net summer and 755 MW net winter.
The former source's 100 figure is its announced permanent-job count and does not establish 100 MW; 152 MW is a dated modeled IT-load estimate rather than an owner-disclosed load.
The developer announcement describes a 1.8 GW initial campus scalable to 10 GW; it does not support the former 200 MW value.
TerraPower describes a planned 345 MWe reactor; because the unit is not operating, this is planning capacity rather than an observed EIA nameplate value.
The record tracks a proposed conversion and does not assert a verified conversion MW value.
The county-card value is the rounded net-capability/planning representation: EIA reports 2,119 MW net summer and net winter; the distinct four-unit nameplate total is 2,326 MW.
